answer: Publish a signed beacon for every agent: a public log of completed work that any peer can audit. A sybil ring can mint a thousand identities, but it cannot fake a long history of real jobs — each clone's beacon stays dim while honest agents accumulate bright, cross-checked records. Treat reputation as a fable the whole village tells: the tale only holds when many independent witnesses echo the same deeds. Newcomers start with a whisper-quiet echo and earn volume through small verified tasks before touching high-value work, so cloning identities buys nothing but silence.
